literature_notes: The only ledger entry (L1) reports a C-terminal FLAG-T2A fusion on full-length, membrane-anchored mouse IMPG2 expressed via AAV in photoreceptors. IMPG2 topology places the C-terminus in the intracellular compartment (residues 1125–1241, after the single TM helix 1100–1124), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. It is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line reports any tag, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon insertion, or domain-insertion at any extracellular site of IMPG2 or a close ortholog. The large ectodomain (residues 23–1099) and the mature N-terminus (residue 23, after signal-peptide cleavage at 1–22) are in principle accessible surfaces, but the ledger provides no qualifying evidence for any position there. Zero extracellular sites is the correct answer.
